ambient: A corner resolves in time for you.
Something behind you goes back to being the general idea.
description: It has been described rather than built, and the description is filled in at whatever you happen to be looking at. Everywhere else is the general idea of a room, held ready. Turn your head and it settles into detail, politely, just before you get there.
name: The Approximate Room

looks: Complete, correct, and only ever where you are.
You catch it arriving once, and it is very good at it.
Behind you it is not being wasted.
objects.name: the detail

looks: A room's worth of intention with nothing spent on it yet.
It holds the shape and none of the contents.
It would do. That is the honest answer.
objects.name: the general idea
